stages.discovery: A stretch of splintered barricade blocks half the road, the Kingdom's crest still legible on a warped shield nailed to the crossbeam. Nothing guards it now. A tally of hash marks is scratched into the wood beside a rota board - names, dates, and a gap where the last several days should be.

choices.label: Read the Rota Board
choices.description: See who was posted here, and when it stopped - Investigation check

check.success_outcome: The last entry is dated over a week ago, the handwriting rushed instead of dismissed - not a shift that ended, but one that never got relieved. Whatever pulled the Kingdom's watch off this road did it in a hurry.
check.failure_outcome: The board's been rained on too many times to make out more than a few scattered names and dates, nothing that adds up to a clear story.

choices.label: Search the Guard Post
choices.description: They left in a hurry - they might have left supplies
choices.outcome: Whoever manned this post left behind a half-eaten ration and a few coins dropped and never missed. You take what's still good and leave the rest to the weather.

choices.label: Keep Moving
choices.description: ESC also cancels - not your patrol to worry about
choices.outcome: You climb over the broken barricade and put the empty watch post behind you.
